memory.label: Memory book
memory.hint: Chat bubbles like in WhatsApp, with a summary page, times and photos if you added a zip.

record.label: Plain record
record.hint: Plain black on white, every message in order with its date and time. Good for printing and keeping.

clean.label: Just the words
clean.hint: Chat bubbles with only the messages people wrote: no times, photo notes, deleted messages or system notes.

ink.label: Save ink and paper
ink.hint: Small plain text with no colour, so a long chat takes the fewest pages.
